question: How many of our customers come back to buy again?
interpretation: Repeat rate = customers with 2 or more non-cancelled orders / customers with at least one. Recent sign-ups have had less time to return, so compare by sign-up year.
sql:
WITH per_user AS (
  SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS orders, MIN(DATE(created_at)) AS first_order
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.orders`
  WHERE status != 'Cancelled'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM first_order) AS first_order_year,
  COUNT(*) AS customers,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(orders >= 2), COUNT(*)), 3) AS repeat_rate
FROM per_user
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
report_guidance: Give the overall rate, then the rate by first-order year, and warn that the latest cohort is not yet comparable.
